rationale.ai-review: Evaluates AI code review benefits, security misses, false positives, and contextual limits.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Advocates static analysis and regression tests to validate AI-reviewed code.
rationale.quality-debt: Reports context-insensitive suggestions causing standards, maintainability, and performance problems.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Documents developers validating AI suggestions and security findings before acceptance.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Advocates XAI to help developers understand and judge AI recommendations.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes replacing developer judgment with fully automated CI/CD.
